description: Better session grouping for Claude Code: nested groups (folders), indented sessions with tree lines, drag & drop, colors and search.
view.title: Claude Groups
config.title: Claude Code Groups
config.language.description: Language of the Claude Groups view and its messages. Command names and these settings follow the display language of VS Code.
config.itemPrefix.description: Prefix of the sessions inside groups.
config.itemIndent.description: Extra left indentation of the items of a group in pixels (relative to the name of the group).
config.showIndentGuide.description: Vertical guide line next to the items of groups (always shown with the “tree” prefix).
config.showTimestamps.description: Show the time of the last activity next to the sessions.
config.sessionOrder.description: Order of the sessions inside groups.
config.sessionOrder.name: By name
config.ungroupedPosition.description: Where the sessions without a group are shown.
config.openOnSingleClick.description: Open a session with a single click (otherwise with a double click).
config.openWith.auto: The Claude Code panel if the Claude Code extension is installed (and claudeCode.useTerminal is off), otherwise a terminal
config.openWith.panel: Always the panel of the Claude Code extension
config.openWith.terminal: Always the plain Claude Code CLI (claude --resume) in the VS Code terminal
config.claudeCommand.description: Path of the claude executable for terminal sessions. Empty: PATH, then the claude binary of the Claude Code extension and of the Claude desktop app.
config.claudeConfigDir.description: The configuration folder of Claude (default: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude).
